conventions: runes-only-no-class-directive: use `:class={...}`; never use Svelte `class:` directives.
Declare reactive Set state with `$state(new Set(...))`; mutate the proxied Set directly.
Reuse createNetwork/createBuffer in ircStore.svelte.test.ts:~200-300 for store tests.
Keep buffer field comments namespaced by their W-plan task ID when editing nearby state.
Plan artifacts live together as plan.yaml + context_envelope.json + plan-summary.md.
reuse-before-rewrite: extend trusted helpers and event paths before adding parallel mechanisms.

hard: Engine changes are in scope in Wave 1.
Wire additions CONNECTION_RETRY_STATUS and CONNECTION_FAIL are allowed and additive.
Redis snapshot schema changes must remain backward-compatible and additive only.
Svelte 5 runes only; bind props with `$props()` and state with `$state()`.
Use `$derived()` or `$derived.by()` for derived state and `:class={...}` for classes.
Cleanup uses an `$effect` return function or `onCleanup`; never leave timer teardown implicit.
The 1s banner refill interval must stop on status change and component unmount.
ServerLogTimeline must preserve ServerFeaturesPanel and the 005 ISUPPORT flow.
Emit both legacy `disconnectReason` and structured `failInfo` during the transition.
`serverlogCollapseEvents` is global, not per-network, matching IRCCloud's model.
Existing CONNECTED, DISCONNECTED, NOTICE, PRIVMSG, and ISUPPORT wire shapes are frozen.
Keep the fiber palette; IRCCloud colors are references and must not become new tokens.
soft: Prefer native details/summary behavior over a custom disclosure component.
Keep visual changes typographic and structural rather than cloning IRCCloud branding.
Prefer pure TypeScript helpers with no Svelte imports for reason and suspicion rules.
Minimize blast radius and avoid unrelated cleanup in the 1,145-line timeline component.
Add no external dependencies unless existing platform APIs cannot meet an acceptance check.
compatibility: Legacy snapshots may omit retryStatus and failInfo; frontend fallback behavior must still work.
New frontend code prefers failInfo but falls back to disconnectReason.
Modern Chromium remains the component-test browser target.
Existing lib and client vitest suites must remain green.
security_requirements: No new credentials, remote origins, or privileged APIs are introduced.
Failure text is rendered as text; structured engine reasons are not treated as markup.

key_dirs: source/ircfiber/irc/ - connection lifecycle and reconnect backoff
source/ircfiber/models/ - synthetic IRC event factories and payload types
source/ircfiber/redis/ and source/ircfiber/engine/ - additive network snapshots
source/ircfiber/api/ - fresh WebSocket state dump serialization
frontend/src/lib/ - pure reason and suspicious-connection helpers
frontend/src/stores/ - network state, preferences, and event application
frontend/src/components/ - connection banner and server-log timeline
patterns: Engine lifecycle state flows through synthetic events and additive NetworkStateSnapshot fields.
Frontend WS dispatch mutates the rune-backed Network object through named store functions.
Structured failInfo is preferred while disconnectReason remains the compatibility fallback.
Server-log attempts retain per-attempt collapse state beneath one global events disclosure pref.

key_components.name: ServerLogCard.svelte

Not the production parity surface and not a rewrite target.

key_components.name: PersistentIRCClient reconnect loop
responsibility: Computes reconnect attempt count and backoff delay.
Owns disconnect reasons and emits lifecycle transitions.

key_components.name: NetworkStateSnapshot
responsibility: Persists network state for resume and fresh-client sync.
Receives additive retryStatus data without breaking older snapshots.

key_components.name: WebSocket state dump

research_digest.what_it_informs: The 11 visible states, retry ordinal/countdown copy, failures, and action branches.
Human-readable reason, SSL verification, restricted, and post-error maps.
The global collapseDisco preference and collapsed connection-event grouping model.
The type_status, type_notice, type_info_response, and type_motd_response classes.
Reference visual grammar: hairlines, restrained fills, spacing, and mono prefixes.
Critic evidence for mapping IRCCloud grammar to existing fiber palette tokens.

prior_decisions.decision: Implement full parity rather than a visual-only restyle.
rationale: The current banner drops lifecycle and failure data, so CSS alone cannot close the UX gap.
Engine, wire, store, and UI changes are all included in the five-wave DAG.

prior_decisions.decision: Collapse connection events by default with one global preference.
rationale: This matches IRCCloud's model and reduces server-log density.
A global key avoids per-network preference proliferation.
Users need visible retry timing and ordinal attempt context.
A 1s interval is acceptable only with status-change and unmount cleanup.

prior_decisions.decision: Dual-emit disconnectReason and failInfo during migration.
rationale: New rendering needs structured reason, SSL, and killed fields.

prior_decisions.decision: Restricted or blocked tier states degrade to the reconnect path in fiber.
rationale: IRC Fiber has no paid-tier upgrade surface.
Generic disconnected behavior preserves function without inventing an upgrade flow.
